name: VidCon
blurb: Online-video and creator-economy convention long held in Anaheim; the brand is merging into a new Nashville event with no further edition announced.
notes: Homepage (rendered 2026-10-04) carries no Anaheim dates at all; it announces that 'VidCon and LIONS are joining forces, launching VidCon x LIONS Creators', debuting as part of a new event called 'Insight to Impact' in Nashville 'in the fall of 2027' with no specific dates given yet. The last confirmed Anaheim edition ran June 25-27, 2026 (per the batch seed note), which ended before the 2026-10-05 research window, so no upcoming VidCon edition can be listed. Marked inactive because VidCon's own site treats this as the brand ending its current Anaheim/fan-convention format in favor of the new industry event; worth revisiting as a new entry if VidCon x LIONS Creators / Insight to Impact announces concrete Nashville dates.
